sceneParallax-name.label: Name
sceneParallax-name.tip: Parallax Name (note: this is a label for user reference only)

sceneParallax-layer.label: Layer
sceneParallax-layer.tip:
Foreground layer always overlaps Background layer, Object layer always overlaps Background layer
If layers are the same type, sorting goes in order with the highest value displayed first
If the order is the same, sorting goes by Object list position

background.name: Background
background.tip: Background layer is always displayed behind (or 'under') Object layer and/or Foreground layer

foreground.name: Foreground
foreground.tip: Foreground layer is always displayed in front of (or 'on top of') Object layer and/or Background layer

sceneParallax-order.label: Order
sceneParallax-order.tip: Parallax images and tile maps on the same layer are sorted in order, with higher values displayed in front

sceneParallax-light.label: Light
sceneParallax-light.tip: Affects the rendering of the selected image (or 'lights & shadows')

anchor.name: Anchor Sampling
anchor.tip: Color is synthesized by sampling light relative to the image's anchor point

global.name: Global Sampling
global.tip: Color is synthesized by sampling multi-pixel locations relative to the image's location

ambient.name: Ambient Light
ambient.tip: Color is a composite of the current Scene's existing lighting

sceneParallax-blend.label: Blend
sceneParallax-blend.tip: Choose a formula to blend the color with the underlying color

sceneParallax-anchorX.label: Anchor X
sceneParallax-anchorX.tip: Horizontal position of rectangular area connection point between Parallax and Scene

sceneParallax-anchorY.label: Anchor Y
sceneParallax-anchorY.tip: Vertical position of rectangular area connection point between Parallax and Scene

sceneParallax-parallaxFactorX.label: Parallax Factor X
sceneParallax-parallaxFactorX.tip: Coefficient for horizontal parallax movement when camera moves

sceneParallax-parallaxFactorY.label: Parallax Factor Y
sceneParallax-parallaxFactorY.tip: Coefficient for vertical parallax movement when camera moves

sceneParallax-shiftSpeedX.label: Shift Speed X
sceneParallax-shiftSpeedX.tip: Parallax's horizontal auto-scroll speed (in pixels per second)

sceneParallax-shiftSpeedY.label: Shift Speed Y
sceneParallax-shiftSpeedY.tip: Parallax's vertical auto-scroll speed (in pixels per second)

sceneParallax-tint-3-box.label: Tint - Grayscale
sceneParallax-tint-3-box.tip: Reduces color saturation (to black & white if high enough)

sceneParallax-conditions.label: Conditions
sceneParallax-conditions.tip: Set a list of conditions for the Parallax to be created; if they aren't met, the Parallax isn't created

sceneParallax-events.label: Events
sceneParallax-events.tip:
$Parallax Events
$Options
Autorun: Event triggers as soon as the Parallax appears (including after reading save data)
Custom: triggered using the 'Call Event' command

sceneParallax-scripts.label: Scripts
sceneParallax-scripts.tip: Add Script files to extend Parallax functions
